subject: Natural Sciences
topic: The birth, life and death of a star
topicAf: Die geboorte, lewe en dood van ’n ster

options: In nebulae, clouds of gas and dust
optionsAf: In newels, wolke van gas en stof
items.explain: Stars form when gravity pulls gas and dust in a nebula together until fusion starts.
items.explainAf: Sterre vorm wanneer swaartekrag gas en stof in ’n newel bymekaartrek totdat fusie begin.

items.q: What starts fusion in a young star?
items.qAf: Wat begin fusie in ’n jong ster?
options: Compression and heating of the core until hydrogen fuses
optionsAf: Kompressie en verhitting van die kern totdat waterstof fuseer
items.explain: Gravity compresses the core, raising the temperature until hydrogen nuclei fuse into helium.
items.explainAf: Swaartekrag druk die kern saam, wat die temperatuur verhoog totdat waterstofkerne tot helium fuseer.

items.q: Our Sun is currently in which stage?
items.qAf: In watter stadium is ons Son tans?
items.explain: The Sun is a main-sequence star, fusing hydrogen into helium in its core.
items.explainAf: Die son is ’n hoofreeksster en fuseer waterstof tot helium in sy kern.

items.q: What does a star like the Sun become at the end of its life?
items.qAf: Wat word ’n ster soos die son aan die einde van sy lewe?
items.explain: After becoming a red giant, a Sun-like star sheds its outer layers and leaves a hot white dwarf.
items.explainAf: Nadat dit ’n rooi reus word, werp ’n son-agtige ster sy buitelae af en laat ’n warm wit dwerg oor.

items.q: A very massive star ends its life in a huge explosion. What is this called?
items.qAf: ŉ Baie massiewe ster eindig sy lewe in ’n groot ontploffing. Wat word dit genoem?
items.explain: Massive stars explode as supernovae, scattering elements that can form new stars and planets.
items.explainAf: Massiewe sterre ontplof as supernovas en strooi elemente wat nuwe sterre en planete kan vorm.

items.q: Why do the heavy elements in our bodies come from stars?
items.qAf: Waarom kom die swaar elemente in ons liggame van sterre?
options: Heavier elements are made in stars and spread by supernovae
optionsAf: Swaarder elemente word in sterre gemaak en deur supernovas versprei
items.explain: Fusion in stars forms heavier elements, which are released into space when the stars die.
items.explainAf: Fusie in sterre vorm swaarder elemente, wat in die ruimte vrygestel word wanneer die sterre sterf.

items.q: The process in a star's core in which hydrogen nuclei join to form helium.
items.qAf: Die proses in ’n ster se kern waarin waterstofkerne saamsmelt om helium te vorm.

items.q: The huge explosion at the end of the life of a very massive star.
items.qAf: Die reuse ontploffing aan die einde van die lewe van ’n baie massiewe ster.

items.q: The small, hot, dense core left when a star like the Sun dies.
items.qAf: Die klein, warm, digte kern wat oorbly wanneer ’n ster soos die Son sterf.

items.q: An object whose gravity is so strong that not even light can escape.
items.qAf: ’n Voorwerp waarvan die swaartekrag so sterk is dat selfs lig nie kan ontsnap nie.

items.text: A star is born in a [[]] of gas and dust. It spends most of its life as a [[]]-sequence star.
items.textAf: ’n Ster word in ’n [[]] van gas en stof gebore. Dit bring die meeste van sy lewe as ’n [[]]reeksster deur.

items.text: When the Sun runs out of hydrogen it will swell into a red [[]] and then shed its outer layers as a [[]] nebula.
items.textAf: Wanneer die Son se waterstof opraak, sal dit opswel tot ’n rooi [[]] en dan sy buitenste lae as ’n [[]] newel afwerp.

items.q: Massive stars live longer than small stars.
items.qAf: Massiewe sterre leef langer as klein sterre.
items.explain: False. Massive stars use their fuel much faster and live shorter lives.
items.explainAf: Onwaar. Massiewe sterre gebruik hul brandstof baie vinniger en leef korter.

items.q: The Sun will end its life as a black hole.
items.qAf: Die Son sal sy lewe as ’n swartkolk eindig.
items.explain: False. The Sun is not massive enough; it will become a white dwarf.
items.explainAf: Onwaar. Die Son is nie massief genoeg nie; dit sal ’n witdwerg word.

items.q: Elements heavier than iron are made in supernova explosions.
items.qAf: Elemente swaarder as yster word in supernova-ontploffings gemaak.
items.explain: True. The extreme conditions in a supernova create heavy elements such as gold.
items.explainAf: Waar. Die uiterste toestande in ’n supernova skep swaar elemente soos goud.

items.q: Put the life cycle of a massive star in order.
items.qAf: Rangskik die lewensiklus van ’n massiewe ster in volgorde.
